body.title: Reconcile meta.lifecycle inside prepareArtifactWrite
body.summary: Make prepareArtifactWrite call reconcileLifecycle for a head that carries meta.lifecycle, taking the actor and time from new optional opts (defaulting to insrc:system and the clock). For such a head the canonical description/body/citations hash decides whether a content write mints a revision, so metadata, lifecycle fields and key order cannot; a head without meta.lifecycle keeps the legacy comparison. Binding requirements 3 and 4.
acceptanceChecks: a content write to a head with meta.lifecycle reconciles hash, number and the fall-back to draft, and a meta-only write leaves them
a metadata-only or key-order-only change to a lifecycle-bearing head, written as content, does not mint a revision
a head without meta.lifecycle is prepared byte for byte as before and the existing storage, artifact-writer and prepare-artifact-write tests pass unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/prepare-lifecycle.test.ts: prepareArtifactWrite reconciles meta.lifecycle for a content write, leaves it for a meta-only write, mints no revision for a metadata-only or key-order-only change, and prepares a head without meta.lifecycle as before
